title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Cloud Platform Engineer  
**Project Role Description :** Designs, builds, tests, and deploys cloud application solutions that integrate cloud and non-cloud infrastructure. Can deploy infrastructure and platform environments, creates a proof of architecture to test architecture viability, security and performance.
  
**Must have skills :** Microsoft Intune  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Specialist, you will act as the technical subject matter expert (SME) responsible for architecting and optimizing enterprise-wide, multi-OS endpoint strategies. You will design resilient provisioning architectures that bridge traditional infrastructure with modern cloud management, establishing robust design patterns for Windows and macOS device fleets via Microsoft Intune and Apple Business Manager.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities  
  
Architecture & Strategy: Spearhead the design, validation, and rollout of heterogeneous device management architectures (Windows, macOS, mobile), ensuring enterprise scalability and zero-trust alignment.  
Advanced Apple Deployment: Architect end-to-end Apple corporate deployments utilizing Apple Automated Device Enrollment (ADE), volume purchase programs (Apps and Books), and advanced DDM policies.  
Identity & Security Architecture: Define and implement robust access paradigms, such as phishing-resistant Platform SSO for macOS, automated File Vault encryption management, and custom compliance frameworks.
  
Optimization & Governance: Lead performance tuning, cross-functional alignment, and troubleshooting for complex multi-OS synchronization bottlenecks, script execution bounds, and policy conflicts.  
Technical Leadership: Guide the organization on modern endpoint trends, moving legacy policies to native cloud primitives (e.g., DDM software updates) and driving automation.  
  
Professional & Technical Skills  
  
Must-Have Skill: Advanced proficiency and minimum 3+ years of deep expertise in Microsoft Intune, featuring heavy exposure to enterprise-grade macOS fleet management and Apple ecosystem integration.  
Proven capability in designing and validating architecture proofs for multi-platform cloud solutions.  
Deep knowledge of Apple security primitives (Secure Enclave, Gatekeeper, XProtect, and DDM status reporting).  
Expert grasp of cloud security postures, identity providers (Microsoft Entra ID / Okta), and hybrid integration models.  
  
Additional Information  
  
Experience Requirement: Minimum 7 years of experience in Microsoft Intune and JAMF  
Location: Gurugram office.  
Education: 15 years of full-time education required.

  
15 years full time education

title: Director, AI Engineering & Architecture, GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
Location: Gurugram, Haryāna, India
  
Date Posted: Oct 13, 2026

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.

  
  

**The Team**

The Global AI & Knowledge Organization (GAIKO) is A&M's central engine for AI strategy, enablement, and knowledge infrastructure. Led by the Chief AI & Knowledge Officer, the team bridges firm strategy and frontline delivery, responsible for how A&M adopts, governs, and scales AI across its practices and geographies. The team's mandate spans the full lifecycle of AI at A&M: from rolling out enterprise tools like Claude to thousands of practitioners across the US, Australia, and Europe, to building the platforms and governance frameworks that ensure AI work is reusable, compliant, and compounding in value over time.

  
  

**How you will contribute**

* Recruit, develop, and grow a global bench of Solution Architects, Applied AI Engineers, platform/config engineers, and DevOps engineers
* Lead the design and delivery of enterprise LLM applications, agents, complex skills, and AI apps that create measurable business value across the firm
* Set the architectural direction for A&M's custom AI product suite, including agent platforms, specialized skills, and internal AI applications
* Establish and enforce standards for software development, CI/CD, testing, release gating, infrastructure automation, and reproducibility across every team building on the platform
* Establish MLOps practices: model and prompt/agent versioning, evaluation pipelines, monitoring, and automated retraining where custom models are in use
* Own the security posture for AI applications and platforms, including data privacy, access control, credential management, model risk, and secure SDLC
* Drive build-vs-buy decisions across LLM providers, enterprise AI platforms, and vendor tools
* Communicate technical tradeoffs, risk, and roadmap progress to senior firm leadership in business terms
* Stay ahead of emerging AI capabilities - agentic architectures, RAG, fine-tuning, knowledge graphs - and run proofs of concept that inform the platform roadmap
  

  

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years in software engineering, platform engineering, or applied AI engineering, including 5+ years leading technical teams
* Demonstrated track record of building and scaling an engineering organization from the ground up
* Deep hands-on background in software architecture, with credibility to review and challenge technical designs from senior engineers and architects
* Hands-on experience with modern AI/LLM application architecture: agent frameworks, RAG, prompting, evaluation, fine-tuning, vector databases, and embeddings
* Experience with SaaS platform/config engineering (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot) as well as custom application development built directly on LLM provider APIs, DevOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation
* Experience with API key management, secrets management, and credential governance across multiple AI/LLM providers
* Experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern data platforms
* Experience with knowledge graph design and implementation (e.g., Neo4j, graph schemas/ontologies, graphbased retrieval) is a plus
* Track record of embedding security and risk management into engineering practice, ideally in a regulated or professional services environment
* Experience operating a global, distributed engineering team across time zones
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required; Master's preferred
  

  
  

**Your journey at A&M**

We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

**Culture & Values**
--------------------

At Alvarez & Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.

* Perform regular security monitoring to identify any possible intrusions.
* Perform daily backup operations, ensuring all required file systems and system data are successfully backed up to the appropriate media, recovery tapes or disks are created, and media is recycled and sent off site as necessary.
* Closely monitoring and developing the procedures for backups of the servers.
* Perform regular file archival and purge as necessary.

**Monitoring, Testing & Troubleshooting**

* Perform daily system monitoring, verifying the integrity and availability of all hardware, server resources, systems and key processes, reviewing system and application logs, and verifying completion of scheduled jobs such as backups.
* Daily monitor the Server Event Logs, Firewall and other security equipment logs and also the logs of scheduled archival software.
* Test the operating system software, the networking software and also the computer hardware.
* Must possess the initiative to resolve issues before they become critical.

**Project Management & Documentation**

* To assist IT Head for technical issues on various projects such as support on testing, rolling out and execution of projects.
* Strong written communication skills including documentation.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Software Development Engineer in Test**

Location Gurugram - Haryana, India

FORVIA HELLA is a listed international automotive supplier. As a company of the FORVIA Group, FORVIA HELLA stands for high-performance lighting technology and vehicle electronics and, with the Lifecycle Solutions Business Group, also covers a broad service and product portfolio for the spare parts and workshop business as well as for manufacturers of special vehicles. With currently around 34,000 employees at over 125 locations, the company is active worldwide and generated adjusted sales of €8.0 billion in the fiscal year 2025.

**YOUR TASKS**

About the Role  
We are looking for a Senior SDET with 6–8+ years of relevant experience to design and develop scalable test automation solutions across UI, API, system integration, and end-to-end testing.  
The role combines software engineering, test automation, CI/CD, cloud, and AI-assisted development. The ideal candidate is a strong Python developer with hands-on experience in modern automation frameworks and a mindset for continuous improvement.  
Key Responsibilities  

Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reusable test automation frameworks and architectures.

Define and implement test automation strategies, including appropriate test levels, coverage, and risk-based testing.  

Develop automated tests for UI, API, system integration, and end-to-end testing.  

Build automation using Python, Pytest, Selenium, Playwright, and Appium.  

Integrate automated testing into Jenkins and GitLab CI/CD pipelines.  

Improve automation coverage, stability, execution efficiency, and reporting.  

Work with AWS-based environments to support scalable test execution.  

Use PowerShell and scripting to automate test execution, environment setup, and supporting engineering tasks.  

Use GitHub Copilot and AI/LLM-based tools for code generation, test creation, debugging, refactoring, and test analysis.  

Explore and implement AI-driven approaches to improve test automation and engineering productivity.  

Collaborate with developers, testers, architects, and product teams in an Agile/Scrum environment

Mentor team members and contribute to automation strategy and technology evolution.

 **YOUR QUALIFICATIONS**  
Required Skills & Qualifications  

* 6–8+ years of relevant experience in software testing, test automation, or SDET

roles.  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, such as

B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, MCA, or M.Tech/M.Sc. in Computer Science.  

* Strong Python programming and object-oriented design skills.
* Strong hands-on experience with Pytest.
* Experience designing test automation architecture, frameworks, reusable

components, and test strategies.  

* Proven experience with Selenium and/or Playwright; Appium experience is an

advantage.  

* Strong experience in REST API testing and automation.
* Practical experience with Jenkins, GitLab, and Git.
* Working knowledge of PowerShell or scripting for automation and engineering

tasks.  

* Basic working knowledge of AWS and cloud-based environments.
* Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or similar AI-assisted development

tools.  

* Good understanding of software testing, QA methodologies, and quality

engineering practices.  

* Good working knowledge of HTML/CSS.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

Good-to-Have  

* System Integration Testing (SIT) experience.
* Performance testing experience.
* Experience with AI-driven test automation or LLM-based testing solutions.
* Docker/containerization experience.
* Automotive domain knowledge.
* Basics of Embedded Systems

  
  
Even if you do not meet all our requirements, do not hesitate to apply to us, because the further development of our employees is very important to us and opens up a wide range of opportunities for you in our company.
  
  
FORVIA HELLA stands for the variety of all employees. Inclusion and diversity are firmly anchored in our company culture. We are continuously looking for new team players and welcome applications from all interested parties, regardless of their ethical and social background, age, religion, gender, disability, sexual orientation or identity.

**About the role**

The Solution Architect Professional supports the solution architecture design, executes the mapping of business requirements and facilitates smooth project delivery empowering the implementation of functional solutions that are fit for purpose and delivered against stated business requirements.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

CLM Configuration & Delivery (Primary)

* Support and optimise CLM processes: authoring, negotiation, approvals, obligation management,

amendments, renewals, and repository.
  

* Configure and validate workflows, templates, clause libraries, metadata, approval rules, and

permissions in Sirion / Icertis (or comparable).
  

* Work through the full SDLC with the development squad — requirements, design review, build support,

and release.  

Requirements Definition & Translation

* Work closely with business stakeholders (Procurement, Legal, Operations) to elicit and define business

requirements.
  

* Translate business requirements into technical requirements — both functional (FRs) and non

functional (NFRs) such as performance, security, availability, scalability, and compliance.
  

* Author functional specs, process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria; maintain requirements

traceability from business need through to delivered solution.
  

* Run workshops and discovery sessions; perform gap analysis against current system capabilities.

Landscape & Dependency Mapping
  

* Maintain an end-to-end view of integrated systems (on-prem, SaaS, AWS-hosted) supporting

procurement and contract workflows.
  

* Map dependencies and data flows across systems; identify integration touchpoints and downstream

impacts of any change.  

Testing & Deployment Assurance

* Plan and execute functional testing, UAT, and regression checks across business scenarios.
* Validate solutions and patches pre- and post-deployment (including sandbox-to-production) to

confirm end-to-end integrity.
  

* Manage defects, coordinate fixes, and sign off releases against acceptance criteria.

  

Stakeholder Management

* Act as liaison between business and technical teams; drive alignment and support user adoption.
* Communicate system impacts, risks, dependencies, and change implications clearly.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* 4–6 years as a System / Business / Functional Analyst in an SDLC delivery environment.
* In-depth, hands-on CLM configuration on Sirion and/or Icertis — workflows, templates,

clauses, metadata, approvals, permissions.
  

* Strong understanding of CLM and Source-to-Contract (S2C) processes.
* Hands-on exposure to drafting, reviewing, and analysing legal contracts and obligations (e.g.

NDAs, SLAs, commercial/SaaS agreements) — enough legal/contractual literacy to
  
understand clause intent, obligations, and risk when configuring CLM.
  

* Functional testing and UAT ownership, including validation before and after deployment.
* Proven experience as the bridge between business and development squads in Agile.
* Ability to define business requirements with stakeholders and translate them into technical

requirements (FRs and NFRs), functional specs, acceptance criteria, and traceability.
  

* Hands-on with Jira and Confluence.
* Clear communication and strong stakeholder management.

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Awareness of integrated enterprise landscapes spanning on-prem, SaaS, and AWS-hosted

apps.
  

* Working knowledge of APIs, integrations, e-signature (DocuSign/Adobe Sign), webhooks,

and data migration.
  

* Sandbox-to-production (P2P) deployment experience.
* Business process mapping (BPMN, Visio, Lucidchart, ARIS).
* Familiarity with SAP Ariba, S/4HANA, Coupa, or Oracle Procurement.
* Root cause analysis and structured problem-solving.

In 1995, in a garage in Melbourne, Australia, REA Group was born from a simple question: “Can we change the way the world experiences property?”


Could we? Yes. Are we done? Never.


Fast forward 30 years, REA Group is a market leader in online real estate in three continents and continuing to grow rapidly across the globe. We’re seeking a Staff Engineer \- EDGE Platform who will play a pivotal role in shaping and scaling REA’s edge security and content delivery capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, cloud, networking and security, with a strong focus on building resilient, reusable and well\-governed edge platform capabilities for teams across REA.

* Mentor engineers, provide technical leadership across team boundaries and help grow a strong engineering culture centred on accountability, ownership and continuous improvement.

**Who we’re looking for:**

* Deep expertise in CDN and edge technologies, ideally including Akamai for CDN, WAF and DDoS protection, with the ability to make sound architectural and operational trade\-offs.
* Strong experience with bot management platforms such as Kasada, or similar capabilities used to detect and mitigate automated abuse at scale.
* Strong depth in AWS and a broad understanding of networking, DNS, TLS, traffic routing and internet\-facing architectures, with the ability to reason across the full request path.
* Advanced proficiency in Terraform and infrastructure as code, including designing reusable modules, standards, abstractions and governance mechanisms for wider engineering adoption.
* Strong software engineering skills in Python and/or Go, with experience building internal tooling, automation and platform integrations used by multiple teams.
* Proven ability to solve ambiguous, high\-impact technical problems across distributed systems and drive outcomes that improve security, reliability, performance and developer experience.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, product, security and leadership stakeholders with varying technical backgrounds.
* A high degree of accountability and ownership, including experience shaping or owning OKRs, driving execution and being responsible for measurable platform outcomes.

**Bonus Points for:**

* Experience designing internal platform capabilities that improve developer experience and adoption through self\-service patterns.
* Exposure to edge security policy management, rate limiting, API protection or zero trust patterns.
* Experience in high\-scale internet platforms where performance, availability and abuse prevention are critical.
* Familiarity with compliance, governance or risk controls in cloud and edge environments.

**What we offer:**

* A hybrid and flexible approach to working.
* Transport options to help you get to and from work, including home pick\-up and drop\-off.
* Meals provided on site in our office.
* Flexible leave options including parental leave, family care leave and celebration leave.
* Insurances for you and your immediate family members.
* Programs to support mental, emotional, financial and physical health \& wellbeing.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities to further your technical expertise.

**The values we live by:**


Our values are at the core of how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. We believe that how we work is equally important as what we do to achieve our goals. This commitment is at the heart of everything we do, from the way we interact with colleagues to the way we serve our customers and communities.

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion:**


We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more effective and fuel disruptive thinking \- be it cultural and ethnic backgrounds, gender identity, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other identity or lived experience. We know diverse teams are critical to maintaining our success and driving new business opportunities. title: 3d visualizer
description:
**Company Description**

**Praxis Group is an Interior Design \& Built Solutions provider based in Gurugram. We deliver residential, commercial, and office interior projects through design consultation, renovation, and turnkey execution, with a strong focus on quality and client satisfaction.**

**Job Description: 3D Designer – Interior Design**

**Job Title:** 3D Designer  
**Department:** Design  
**Industry:** Interior Design / Architecture / Furniture  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 1–4 years  
**Location:** Gurgaon

Salary – 30K – 45K  
**Reporting To:** Design Head / Senior Interior Designer

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **3D Designer** to join our interior design team. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of interior spaces, materials, furniture, lighting, and visual aesthetics, along with the ability to convert 2D concepts and design ideas into high\-quality 3D visualizations.

The candidate will be responsible for creating realistic 3D models, renders, walkthroughs, and presentation visuals for residential and/or commercial interior projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create detailed **3D models and realistic renders** for interior spaces based on design concepts, layouts, and drawings.
* Develop 3D views for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, offices, retail spaces, hospitality projects, and other interiors.
* Translate **2D floor plans, elevations, and design concepts** into accurate 3D models.
* Select and apply appropriate materials, textures, colors, furniture, fixtures, and lighting.
* Produce high\-quality **photorealistic renders** for client presentations and design approvals.
* Prepare multiple design options and make revisions based on client and design\-team feedback.
* Coordinate with interior designers, architects, project managers, and execution teams to ensure design accuracy.
* Maintain accurate dimensions and ensure that 3D designs are practical and aligned with actual site conditions.
* Create mood boards, material presentations, and visual concepts when required.
* Stay updated with current interior design trends, materials, finishes, furniture styles, and visualization techniques.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned 3D design and rendering projects.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **3D modeling, rendering, lighting, materials, and texturing**.
* Proficiency in software such as:
* **3ds Max / SketchUp**
* **V\-Ray / Corona Renderer / Enscape / Lumion**
* **AutoCAD**
* **Photoshop**
* Good understanding of **interior design principles, space planning, materials, and furniture**.
* Ability to create realistic lighting and material finishes.
* Strong attention to detail and visual sense.
* Ability to understand technical drawings and architectural plans.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work on multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Strong creative and problem\-solving abilities.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma/Bachelor's degree in **Interior Design, Architecture, 3D Visualization, or a related field**.
* 1–4 years of relevant experience in interior design visualization or 3D rendering.
* Candidates with a strong portfolio of interior projects will be preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in any of the following will be an advantage:

* Residential interiors
* Modular kitchens and wardrobes
* Commercial interiors
* Retail and hospitality projects
* Furniture visualization
* Photorealistic architectural rendering
* 360° views and walkthroughs

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Quality and realism of 3D visualizations
* Accuracy of designs and dimensions
* Turnaround time for renders and revisions
* Ability to understand and implement design briefs
* Number of revisions required due to design/technical errors
* Coordination with the design and project teams
* Client satisfaction with presentation visuals

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

The Solution Architect – FinTech is responsible for defining, designing, and delivering end\-to\-end technical and business solutions across digital payments, mobile money, lending, KYC, digital identity, merchant solutions, and financial services platforms. The architect will lead solution scoping, requirement analysis, technical design, and deployment oversight while ensuring compliance, security, performance, and regulatory alignment across markets.

  

Key Responsibilities


FinTech Solution Design \& Architecture  

Design scalable, secure, and regulatory\-compliant solutions for digital payments, wallets, merchant transactions, lending, credit scoring, and financial ecosystem integrations.  

Analyze customer financial operations, transaction flows, risk controls, and compliance requirements to define optimized solutions.  

Translate business requirements into detailed technical designs spanning cloud, APIs, microservices, protocols, and core financial systems.  

Ensure solutions adhere to financial industry standards (PCI\-DSS, ISO 8583, ISO 20022, AML/CFT, data privacy, etc.).  

Customer Engagement \& Consultative Advisory

Conduct infrastructure capacity planning, performance evaluation, and transaction throughput modeling.  

Work closely with product, engineering, risk, and operations teams to ensure successful deployment.  

Cross\-Functional Collaboration  

Collaborate with product roadmap teams, R\&D, and engineering to translate market needs into platform features.  

Provide continuous feedback to improve solutions, architecture patterns, and product capabilities.

  

Technical Skills


Architecture design (cloud/on\-prem), microservices, containerization, high\-availability and DR setups.  

Performance tuning, capacity estimation, and infra planning for high\-volume financial transactions.


Strong understanding of digital payments, wallets, mobile money, merchant acquiring, lending platforms, KYC/AML, fraud systems, and transaction processing.  

Experience with financial protocols and integrations — ISO 8583, ISO 20022, REST/JSON APIs, SOAP, SFTP, OAuth2, JWT, Webhooks.  

Knowledge of financial compliance, risk controls, settlement processes, reconciliation, and transaction dispute flows.  

Experience with AI/ML and automation in financial use cases (fraud detection, credit prediction, operational optimization).  

Business \& Leadership Skills  

Strong consultative and customer\-facing capabilities.  

Financial acumen to understand revenue models, pricing, ROI, and commercial impact.  

Ability to mentor, guide teams, and collaborate across multi\-functional units.  

Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and negotiation skills.
